latest.notes:
Pause any element to keep it out of the log without moving it.

Right-click in the Library and choose Pause (or use the switch in Edit Metadata). A paused element keeps its category, its subcategory and its history — the scheduler simply won't pick it. Resume puts it straight back; there is no re-filing to undo. The Library shows a PAUSED pill on the row, and the right-click menu offers Resume once everything you have selected is paused.

This replaces the usual workaround of shunting something into a junk category to stop it airing, which loses its filing and makes your rotation reports wrong. Paused songs no longer count toward a rotation's pool either, so the separation arithmetic in the log report tells the truth about what can actually be picked.

Pausing is not the same as disabling: anything already sitting in a log, or dragged in by hand, still airs. It means 'stop choosing this', not 'never play it'.
